summary: Building a diagnostic web application that monitors real-time data integrity and surfaces system health across the tools the team already uses.
highlights: Designed and developed a diagnostic web application for monitoring real-time data integrity and consistent end-user delivery.
Engineered an end-to-end feedback mechanism that aggregates user input and visualizes it in the diagnostic dashboard.
Integrated GitHub, Jira, and Slack data sources to automate performance and system-health tracking.
overview: Aude.ai needed visibility into whether data reaching end users stayed accurate and complete as it moved through the system.
The work centred on a diagnostic dashboard that brings monitoring, user feedback, and cross-platform health metrics into one place.
